mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(RK1,'') AS RK1 , ISNULL(RK2,'') AS RK2 , ISNULL(RK3,'') AS RK3 , ISNULL(RK4,'') AS RK4 , ISNULL(RK5,'') AS RK5 , ISNULL(RK6,'') AS RK6 , ISNULL(RK7,'') AS RK7 , ISNULL(RK8,'') AS RK8 , ISNULL(RK9,'') AS RK9 , ISNULL(HDDT ,'') AS HDDT , ISNULL(DHDT ,'') AS DHDT , ISNULL(DGDT ,'') AS DGDT , ISNULL(PGDT ,'') AS PGDT , ISNULL(PPDT ,'') AS PPDT , ISNULL(HCDT ,'') AS HCDT , ISNULL(HTDT ,'') AS HTDT , ISNULL(SADT ,'') AS SADT , ISNULL(INDT ,'') AS INDT , ISNULL(YADT1,'') AS YADT1 , ISNULL(YADT2,'') AS YADT2 , ISNULL(SCRDT,'') AS SCRDT , ISNULL(PAPDT,'') AS PAPDT FROM JAJAERK ORDER BY J_DATE DESC

SELECT A1.THICKPOS,A1.J_SERIAL , A1.GUBUN1 , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.SELLPRC1,0),'#,0') AS SELLPRC1 --대한단가 , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.SELLPRC2,0),'#,0') AS SELLPRC2 --현대제철 , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.SELLPRC3,0),'#,0') AS SELLPRC3 --동국(포항) , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.SELLPRC4,0),'#,0') AS SELLPRC4 --포스코(광양) , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.SELLPRC5,0),'#,0') AS SELLPRC5 --포스코(포항) , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.SELLPRC6,0),'#,0') AS SELLPRC6 --한국철강 , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.SELLPRC7,0),'#,0') AS SELLPRC7 --한국특강 , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.SELLPRC8,0),'#,0') AS SELLPRC8 --세아창원 , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.DANGA,0),'#,0') AS SELLPRC9 --인근(기준) , A1.LASTDATE FROM JAJAE A1 WHERE (A1.THICKPOS < 800 OR A1.THICKPOS BETWEEN 900 AND 998) -- 슈레더:800번대로 설정, 슈레더 B,C,D 는 위에 표시되어야함 ORDER BY A1.THICKPOS

SELECT A1.J_SERIAL , A1.GUBUN1 , FORMAT(ISNULL(A2.DANGA,0),'#,0') AS BFDAN , FORMAT(ISNULL(A1.DANGA,0),'#,0') AS ATDAN , REPLACE(FORMAT(CONVERT(DATE,A2.J_DATE),'M/dd'),'-','/') AS BFDATE , REPLACE(FORMAT(CONVERT(DATE,A1.LASTDATE),'M/dd'),'-','/') AS ATDATE FROM JAJAE A1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY J_SERIAL ORDER BY J_DATE DESC) AS ROWNUM , J_DATE , J_SERIAL , DANGA FROM JAJAEHIS ) A2 ON A1.J_SERIAL = A2.J_SERIAL AND A2.ROWNUM = 1 WHERE (A1.THICKPOS <= 998 AND A1.THICKPOS BETWEEN 800 AND 899) -- 슈레더:800번대로 설정, 슈레더 B,C,D 는 위에 표시되어야함 ORDER BY A1.THICKPOS
